description: This file contains utility functions for filtering, cloning, and managing test suites and test cases within a testing framework, specifically for Playwright's test suite management.

methods.name: filterSuite
methods.description: Filters a suite and its child suites and tests based on provided suite and test filters.

methods.name: filterTestsRemoveEmptySuites
methods.description: Removes tests from a suite based on a filter and prunes empty suites.

methods.name: bindFileSuiteToProject
methods.description: Clones a suite and associates it with a specific project, assigning IDs and inheriting properties.

methods.name: applyRepeatEachIndex
methods.description: Applies a repeat index to tests within a suite, updating their IDs and hashes accordingly.

methods.name: filterOnly
methods.description: Filters a suite to only include items marked as 'only'.

methods.name: filterSuiteWithOnlySemantics
methods.description: Recursively filters suites and tests to only include 'only' marked items.

methods.name: filterByFocusedLine
methods.description: Filters suites and tests based on focused line filters, matching file, line, and column.

methods.name: createFileMatcherFromFilter
methods.description: Creates a file matcher function based on a test file filter.
